post.summary: Upload one evidence file (JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, at most 20 MB): private, never public; images are re-encoded without metadata

parameters.name: case
parameters.description: An open claim of the uploader to add the file to; without it the file waits for a claim.

parameters.name: Content-Length
parameters.description: The size of the file; refused above 20 MB before the body is read.

201.description: The stored file: its id, type, size, both hashes and the app's download address (never a storage address).

400.description: An empty file, or one that ended before its Content-Length.

403.description: A cross-site request with a cookie session.

404.description: No such open claim of yours.

409.description: The claim has 20 files, or has been decided.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF by its magic bytes, or an image that cannot be read.

429.description: 20 files not yet in a claim were uploaded in 24 hours.

get.summary: Download an evidence file: the uploader, the teacher of the request, the assigned reviewers and the administrators; 404 for anyone else

200.description: The file, as an attachment (Content-Disposition: attachment, Cache-Control: no-store, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff).

404.description: No such file, or not one this session may open (one answer for both).

get.summary: One rendition of a person's current profile photo or (M16) of another photo of their gallery (WebP, no metadata): everyone for a public person; for a person who is not public only the person's own account and staff; 404 otherwise

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The photo id (photos.get, or `photo` on a person in any public answer).

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The first 16 hex digits of the photo's content hash.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The size: the 96 px card thumbnail, the 512 px profile image, or (M16) the whole photo of a gallery photo (the 512 px square for a photo stored before M16).

200.description: The image (Content-Type: image/webp; ETag: the content hash; Cache-Control: public, no-cache (revalidated with the ETag) for a public person, private, no-store otherwise).

404.description: No such photo, a replaced or removed one, or a person this session may not see (one answer for all).

503.description: The photo store did not deliver the image in time (5 s) or failed; Cache-Control: no-store. Try again later.

get.summary: One rendition of a school's logo or room photo (WebP, no metadata, no location): everyone for a public school; for a school that is not public only the account that listed it and staff; 404 otherwise

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The photo id (`logo` or `photos` of schools.get, or schoolPhotos.get).

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The first 16 hex digits of the photo's content hash.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The 96 px or 512 px square (a logo whole on a transparent square), or the whole room photo.

200.description: The image (Content-Type: image/webp; ETag: the content hash; Cache-Control: public, no-cache for a public school, private, no-store otherwise).

404.description: No such photo, a replaced or removed one, or a school this session may not see (one answer for all).

503.description: The photo store did not deliver the image in time (5 s) or failed; Cache-Control: no-store. Try again later.

get.summary: One rendition of an event's poster (WebP, no metadata, no location): everyone while the event is published or cancelled; 404 once it is removed

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event id (`poster` of events.list and events.get carries the whole address).

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The first 16 hex digits of the poster's content hash.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The 96 px or 512 px square, or the whole poster.

200.description: The image (Content-Type: image/webp; ETag: the content hash; Cache-Control: public, no-cache).

404.description: No such poster, a replaced one, or an event that was removed (one answer for all).

503.description: The photo store did not deliver the image in time (5 s) or failed; Cache-Control: no-store. Try again later.

get.summary: One rendition of a passport's scanned certificate (WebP, no metadata, no location): everyone while the profile shows it (a public entry of a public person on a plan with the full passport); otherwise only the student's own account and their teachers; 404 for anyone else

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The certificate id (`image` of an entry of passport.get or passport.mine carries the whole address).

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The first 16 hex digits of the certificate's content hash.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The 96 px or 512 px square, or the whole scan.

200.description: The image (Content-Type: image/webp; ETag: the content hash; Cache-Control: public, no-cache while the profile shows it, private, no-store otherwise).

404.description: No such certificate, a removed one, or one this session may not see (one answer for all).

503.description: The store did not deliver the image in time (5 s) or failed; Cache-Control: no-store. Try again later.

get.summary: The event as an iCalendar file (RFC 5545): one VEVENT in UTC, STATUS:CANCELLED once cancelled, SEQUENCE the revision; 404 for a removed event

404.description: No such event, or one that was removed.
